purpose.summary: Connect the accepted Bitcoin Static block-event observer to the persistent Chronik ALP/SLP runtime on explicit local regtest while keeping failures isolated from node correctness.
scope: Bridge accepted connected and disconnected blocks from the existing bounded observer into the persistent Chronik runtime through a panic-contained C ABI.
Store the runtime below the node index directory, resume the indexed tip after restart and explicitly rebuild it for full or chainstate reindex.
Keep callbacks asynchronous through a bounded 512-event queue so indexing latency cannot block validation callbacks.
Disable only the persistent runtime after a runtime contradiction or unavailable historical block while the standalone node and volatile bounded observer continue.
Build and exercise the compiled-out, compiled-in-disabled and explicit local-regtest indexing profiles in public CI.
Make inherited compilation units explicitly include the standard declarations they use on current Linux compilers.
exclusions: No consensus, validation, mempool-admission, activation, chain-selection, wallet, P2P, network-identity or mainnet parameter change is included.
No HTTP, gRPC, websocket, RPC, served query API, mempool index or public production deployment is added.
No private history, private source, operator data, incoming report, binary, build output or host-specific path is tracked.

commands: Configure and build bitcoind with BUILD_CHRONIK_OBSERVER=OFF from the exact public parent and verify that no Rust or Chronik runtime edge is present.
expected_results: The standalone node remains independent of Chronik and preserves the accepted parent behavior.

commands: Configure and build bitcoind plus test_bitcoin with BUILD_CHRONIK_OBSERVER=ON, leave -chronikobserver disabled, and run chronik_event_envelope_tests.
expected_results: The bridge and runtime compile, boundary tests pass, and the disabled runtime is not registered or opened.

commands: Enable -chronikobserver=1 only on local regtest and run the asset, block and pruned observer functional matrices from isolated datadirs.
expected_results: Accepted ALP/SLP block streams persist across restart and rebuild, exact-tip disconnects reverse state, and runtime failures never affect node correctness.

scenarios.command: Run feature_chronik_asset_observer.py against the compiled-in candidate from a fresh datadir.
expected_results: Explicit local-regtest opt-in creates the persistent runtime beneath blocks/index/chronik and indexes accepted asset events.
failure_conditions: Implicit enablement, missing runtime state, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the restart section of feature_chronik_block_observer.py with the persistent runtime enabled.
expected_results: The durable runtime resumes at the accepted tip while the bounded volatile projection reconstructs consistently.
failure_conditions: Tip divergence, lost token state, callback blockage, cleanup failure, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the full-reindex section of feature_chronik_block_observer.py.
expected_results: Full reindex explicitly resets and reconstructs the persistent runtime from accepted ordered block callbacks.
failure_conditions: Stale state adoption, incomplete rebuild, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the chainstate-reindex section of feature_chronik_block_observer.py.
expected_results: Chainstate reindex resets and reconstructs the persistent runtime without changing chain selection.
failure_conditions: Stale state adoption, incomplete rebuild, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run feature_chronik_pruned_observer.py with pruning and persistent indexing enabled.
expected_results: Available accepted blocks index normally; an unavailable historical block disables only persistent indexing while the node and volatile observer continue.
failure_conditions: Node shutdown, validation effect, silent persistent continuation, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the deep-reorg section of feature_chronik_block_observer.py.
expected_results: Exact-tip disconnects reverse persistent state; a contradiction fails closed within the indexing layer and does not affect node correctness.
failure_conditions: Silent state corruption, node-authority effect, callback deadlock, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

limitations: The adapter is explicit local-regtest-only and has no served API, mempool index, wallet integration or production deployment contract.
The persistent runtime can rebuild only from readable accepted block data; pruning can therefore disable the persistent layer until an operator supplies a reconstructible datadir or reindex source.
The bounded asynchronous queue is intentionally finite; saturation disables only the persistent runtime instead of blocking node callbacks.
Local macOS builds and functional runs are component observations only; this under-review record attaches no public evidence and claims neither Observed nor Reproduced.
Native compiler, libclang and RocksDB build outputs are not bit-reproducibly pinned.
counterevidence: A 64-event queue saturated during the first deep-reorg run when RocksDB writes lagged the callback burst; the reviewed bound is now 512 and the complete scenario passes, but sustained overload remains an explicit runtime-disable condition.
A pruned datadir can make an accepted historical block unavailable to the persistent runtime; the required behavior is to disable persistence while the node and volatile observer continue.
The first asset functional expectation used a path outside the node index directory; the test now binds the actual blocks/index/chronik location.

The first two public Ubuntu build attempts exposed missing direct standard-library includes in the inherited MIT-licensed client-version and locked-pool compilation units; this change adds cstdint to the former and the directly used limits, stdexcept and utility headers to the latter.

The third public Ubuntu build selected an older versioned libclang shared object before the installed development symlink; the workflow now selects the highest unversioned libclang.so path and fails closed if none exists.

The fourth public Ubuntu build exposed another inherited transitive-include dependency: base58.h used uint8_t without directly including cstdint; this change makes that declaration self-contained without changing Base58 behavior.

The fifth public Ubuntu build reached 244 of 317 native targets before the inherited cuckoocache unit test used std::deque without directly including deque; this change adds only that test-source declaration.

The sixth public Ubuntu build reached 295 of 317 native targets before consensus/validation.h used uint8_t reject-code constants without directly including cstdint; this change makes the declarations self-contained without altering validation behavior or values.

The imported donor bridge remains excluded because it targets a different node API and wider service surface; this adapter is independently authored against the accepted Bitcoin Static observer boundary.
